__broaden__.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’
__broaden__.τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
__broaden__.ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’
__broaden__.ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’)
__broaden__.μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’)
__broaden__.πέρι: περί — around, about, exceedingly; adv. with anastrophe (accent thrown back): ’beyond all others’ (πέρι κέρδεα οἶδεν) · also preposition with anastrophe + acc., of place: ’around’ (ἄστυ πέρι ’around the city’)
__broaden__.ἀκτῆς: ἀκτή — grain, meal (a distinct epic word, homonym of ἀκτή ’shore’); gen. sg. · also ἀκτή ’shore, headland’, fem. gen. sg. (ἐπ’ ἀκτῆς ’on the shore’)
__broaden__.ἐθελούσῃ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. dat. sg.: ’unwilling’ (οὐκ ἐθελούσῃ) · also without a negative: ’willing’ (οὐκ ἐθέλων ἐθελούσῃ ’he unwilling, she willing’)
__broaden__.ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
__broaden__.ἄπυστος: ἄπυστος — unheard of, of whom nothing is learned (from root of πυνθάνομαι); masc. nom. sg. · also active, ’without tidings, not having heard’ (οὐδὲ δὴν ἦεν ἄπυστος ’nor was he long without tidings’)
__broaden__.ἀργαλέον: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, troublesome; neut. nom. sg., impersonal predicate governing an inf. · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’grievous, hard’ (δεινόν τ’ ἀργαλέον τε, of λαῖτμα)
__broaden__.θεά: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form): ’goddess!’
__broaden__.θεοί: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
__broaden__.ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’)
__broaden__.ἐποιχομένη: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro at, ply; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg. (ἱστὸν ἐποιχομένη ’plying the loom’) · also ’go at, come upon, assail’ (βελέεσσιν ἐποιχομένη ’coming upon him with her shafts’)
__broaden__.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship) · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοί περ αὐτῇ, μοι αὐτῇ ’for me myself’)
